g.text: U16 D=1, PRE_N=1. NRST/PC3 low asynchronously clears Q.

g.desc: U16 D=1, PRE_N=1. NRST/PC3 low asynchronously clears Q.

g.text: Releasing reset alone does NOT restore power; a new PC4 rising edge is required.

g.text: Q controls TPS22919 ON; Q AND delayed-Q controls both analog switches.
